options.name: --solution
options.description: Reuse the selected solution scope.

commands.description: Show the stable Roslyn syntax structure of one C# document or symbol.

options.name: --solution
options.description: Reuse the selected solution scope for a symbol target.

options.name: --project
options.description: Reuse the selected project scope for a symbol target.

options.name: --path
options.description: Reuse an explicit symbol-search scope, including external paths.

options.description: Include generated C# source explicitly. [default: False]

options.description: Return every outline item without a count limit. [default: False]
